| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Angles** `angles` | 180 | 8 to 720 | How many projection angles, spread evenly over 180 degrees. |
| **Wavelet** `wavelet` | Daubechies 4 (db4) | Haar, Daubechies 2 (db2), Daubechies 4 (db4), Daubechies 8 (db8), Symlet 4 (sym4), Symlet 8 (sym8) | The 1-D orthogonal wavelet applied along each projection. Its filter taps come from PyWavelets. |
| **Levels** `levels` | 4 | 1 to 8 | How many levels the 1-D transform has. It is capped at the deepest level the projection length allows. |
| **Threshold factor** `factor` | 3 | 0 to 8 | The threshold is this factor times the noise level of each projection, estimated from its finest details. 0 keeps every coefficient. |
| **Shrink rule** `mode` | Hard | Hard, Soft | Hard thresholding sets small coefficients to 0 and keeps the others. Soft thresholding also moves the others toward 0 by T. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
